note: Maintainer factor experiment on the official v3 published path. Forecast cells call presentValue() (linear fade over the explicit window, finite terminal years, then continuation) with the official discount max(10%, ceil(local 10y)+6) and the official 4% terminal. Discount and terminal are not tuned to this sample. Bases are crossed with growth rules: earnings is toStock() earnings_base (normalised EPS, or the latest fiscal year when the synchronous upshift rule fires); cash is toStock() cash_base; midpoint is the arithmetic mid of the two when both are positive, used only as a factor; officialSelected is blendOfficialBase() (earnings-primary below a 50% gap, midpoint at 50–200%, refuse above 200%; financial residual-income names are not cash-blended). Growth rules are zero, the clipped five-year window, the clipped ten-year window, and officialGrowth() (slower of the two clipped windows). The main growth comparison is officialSelected crossed with those four rates, never a mixed-base table. Realised cash is the observed ten-year after-capex cash path plus the same official terminal tail. Realised owner earnings use the same scorer on post-entry EPS when epsObservations are present (OE=E under M≈D); the frozen 2006 debug panel does not include those EPS outcomes. The 2006-03-15 five-name US industrials set is a harness debug set, not a general acceptance sample. Beating zero growth is not a publication gate and is not a license to change official growth or discount. This is not an official published value.

path.forecast: src/lib/dcf.js presentValue: linear fade from starting growth to the effective terminal, 10 explicit years, 10 finite terminal years, then a continuation value. addToFairValue is false.
path.baseSelection: src/lib/stockRecord.js toStock plus src/lib/dcf.js blendOfficialBase, the same official-selected base policyValue() uses.
path.discount: max(10%, ceil(local 10y)+6); not adjusted to market prices or to this sample.
path.terminal: POLICY_V1 4% terminal growth, 10 finite terminal years, continuation capped 2 percentage points below the discount rate.
path.realisedCash: Discount observed FY+1..+10 after-capex cash per share, then attach the same finite terminal years and continuation from the last observed cash flow.
path.realisedOwnerEarnings: Same published-path scorer on observed post-entry EPS when the panel provides epsObservations. Under the disclosed M≈D proxy, owner earnings equal earnings. Missing on the 2006 debug panel.

bases.earnings: toStock() earnings_base: five-year normalised EPS, or the latest complete fiscal year when the synchronous upshift rule fires.
bases.cash: toStock() cash_base: three-year positive after-capex cash median, or the latest fiscal year when the upshift rule fires.
bases.midpoint: Arithmetic mid of earnings and cash when both are positive. A factor cell, not automatically the official published base.
bases.officialSelected: blendOfficialBase(earnings, cash): earnings if the symmetric gap is under 50%, midpoint at 50–200%, refuse above 200%. This is the official published base for owner-model names.

growths.zero: Starting growth 0%, still fading to the official 4% terminal on the published path.
growths.five: The five-year earnings window after the official 0% floor and 15% cap. Null when that window cannot be formed.
growths.ten: The ten-year earnings window after the official 0% floor and 15% cap. Null when that window cannot be formed.
growths.slower: officialGrowth(): slower of the two clipped windows, or the one available window.

definitions.cells: Each cell is the SMAPE between publishedPathValue(base, growth) and the named realised published-path value. Read down a column to compare bases at one growth rule; read across a row to compare growth rules at one base. Do not compare earnings-plus-slower with cash-plus-zero as if that were a growth test.

debugSet.universeRule: Frozen 2006-03-15 entry-date cash panel from scripts/research/cash-path-inputs.json. Six US names drawn from a period industrial/tech filing set; VZ has no complete cash path. This is a harness debug set, not a general acceptance sample.

blockers: No frozen expansion panel is committed under scripts/research/forecast-validation-panels/.

An honest panel needs an entry-date universe fixed at the time (not today's survivors), fundamentals visible on the entry date only (filed and period-end filters, no look-ahead), and ten subsequent fiscal years of both after-capex cash and earnings.
This repository has no committed SEC as-of facts cache, and no walk-forward cash-and-earnings panels beyond the 2006-03-15 debug set.
The 2006 debug panel itself has no post-entry EPS series, so the owner-earnings target cannot be scored until a frozen epsObservations sidecar is added.
Desired coverage once those inputs exist: later entry dates, A/H listings, platforms, and cyclicals, stored as separate labeled expansion results.
expansion.howToAdd: Add a frozen JSON panel under scripts/research/forecast-validation-panels/ with asOf, yieldPct, universeRule, and companies[{ ticker, epsFrom1995 or epsSeries, baseYears, revenueChecks, observations or cashObservations, epsObservations }]. Then rerun npm run research:forecast. Do not back-cast a universe from later survivors.

legacyConstantGordon.note: Retired 口径, kept so the old mixed table can be reproduced. officialMixed is five-year earnings median plus slower-window growth; flatCashZero is three-year cash median plus zero growth. Those two columns are not a same-base growth comparison. fiveMedTen vs fiveMedSlower holds the earnings median fixed. officialSelectedTen/Slower/Zero use toStock plus blendOfficialBase (the 50–200% midpoint rule) but still the constant-explicit-plus-Gordon scorer, not presentValue(). Not a license to change official policy.
